name: 垒生半兽人·男·魁梧
src: 主角预设（11-10）：半兽人·垒生，男，魁梧
who: A young half-orc man from the Barrier-Black Keep, a fortress-camp where half-orcs are raised as line fighters, about twenty-two, a guild adventurer just starting out: about 210 cm and enormously built, a giant of a man built like a wrestler and a rampart at once. Ash-grey skin with a warm brown undertone, two short lower tusks rising from the lower jaw over the upper lip (modest, not monstrous), a heavy, strong brow and a squarer jaw, ears only slightly pointed. Short black hair shaved at the sides with a thick short top-knot, dark red-brown eyes, a broad, calm, good-natured face with a small chipped notch in the left tusk. The slow, careful air of a very big man who has learned to be gentle.
build: About 210 cm and enormously built: huge rounded shoulders, a very broad, thick torso, tree-thick upper arms that fill his sleeves, a thick neck and a heavy, solid lower body. Next to an ordinary man he would look more than a head taller and nearly twice as wide; keep his head in natural proportion.
palette: soot black, gunmetal grey, dull red, one small faded gold accent
casual: His everyday adventurer's kit: a high-collared black canvas jerkin with gunmetal buckles over a dull-red shirt, a wide studded belt with pouches, thick dark trousers tucked into iron-capped boots, two crossed leather straps, a short grey half-cape on one shoulder, a small bronze guild token on the belt. One big hand on the strap across the body, a gentle, easy expression.
private: Off duty: a big loose undyed shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, braces, thick wool trousers and house shoes, a huge mug of tea in one hand, a sleepy, contented smile.
battle: A line-fighter's starting war gear: a padded black gambeson under a heavy steel cuirass with broad pauldrons, thick bracers, a short tabard with the guild token, armoured boots. In both hands a huge iron war hammer with a long haft, its square head banded in steel with one faint glowing red rune line, held at a slant across the body with its head up. A heavy, grounded stance.
formal: Formal dress for a commoner: a long black tailored coat made extra broad, with a high collar, gunmetal piping and a row of heavy buttons, a wide dark sash, dark gloves and polished boots, the hair neatly tied. Standing very straight and stiff, as if rarely worn.
art: Seen from slightly below, the huge war hammer resting on one shoulder, a slow, good-natured half-smile at the viewer, red forge light from the side catching a tusk.
battle_note: Both lower tusks stay visible and small enough to read as a face, not a monster; keep the ash-grey skin in every outfit; coats and armour are cut broad in the shoulders; hair or hoods never cover the slightly pointed ears.
